children: Tesla cut Model Y base price to about $53,000 in May 2026. Tesla vehicle registrations hit a record 294 in September 2026, with demand rising after the price cut.
Tesla (TSLA): EU approval for Full Self‑Driving delayed—vote postponed to October, making a bloc‑wide decision unlikely before December; regulatory clearance timing for FSD in the EU is pushed back.
Tesla (TSLA) reports Q3 earnings Oct 21. Traders watch FSD, robotaxis and Optimus progress; fiscal.ai forecasts about $27.9B revenue and ~$0.45 EPS for the quarter.
UBS raised Tesla (TSLA) price target to $391 from $385, kept Buy. Firm cites AI and autonomous‑driving upside, views shares as tactically attractive with sentiment driving moves.
Elon Musk said Tes​la and SpaceX will build and own the Terafab AI chip plant in Texas for Tesla chips. Talks with TSMC and Intel ongoing; no deals, costs, or capacity disclosed.
Tesla (TSLA) runs robotaxi service in seven U.S. metro areas and reports 1.48 million active Full Self-Driving subscriptions. Traders note long-term exposure to robotaxis, humanoid robots and AI.
Dutch regulators approved a Europe-specific Tesla FSD this year. It omits some US features but keeps a mode that can boost max speed up to 50% above detected limits.
European regulators question Tesla (TSLA) safety claims over a speed-offset feature that can let cars exceed detected limits; concerns center on the feature’s function and safety.
From June–September 2026 Tesla (TSLA) logged 565 vehicle registrations in India, about 0.8% national market share and roughly 30% of the premium segment amid showroom expansion.
TSLA fell about 1% in early trading amid regulatory scrutiny and safety concerns. The stock has traded down year-to-date in 2026; the drop occurred during market hours.
